level_id_bank.verdict: Swing/positional, constructive. HSCL is a long-base specialty-chemical name (2007-2018 base) in a confirmed multi-year uptrend: daily price 692.35 sits above the full MA stack (EMA21 659.82 / EMA36 636.91 / SMA50 617.70 / EMA200 526.96), daily Supertrend is GREEN (601.47), and the Bull Market Support Band (559/583) is rising beneath it. Price has just reclaimed the prior breakout high (688.70) and is pressing into the headline 725-728 overhead gate where ALL THREE fib ladders converge (12M 4.115 + 1M 3.618 + recent 1.115). Momentum is up but the name is moderately extended (~5% above EMA21, ~12% above SMA50) and capped at a strong resistance -> bias = accumulate-on-strength / buy-the-dip, NOT chase. Preferred entry = a pullback into the 603-642 primary buy box (daily SMA50 + EMA36 + 12M 3.618, operator olive box); deeper add into the 556-583 BMSB zone. Alternative = breakout-add on a daily/weekly close >728. Targets: 725-728 (gate, trim-40) -> 776-792 -> 811-822 (->855); blue-sky 887/973/1047 on the recent ladder. Invalidation: daily close <556 (12M 3.115 + 20W SMA) voids the structural thesis; loss of 603 (buy-box lip / 1M 2.618) cools the near-term setup.
